headline: S&P Global Ratings Upgrades Aeromexico to BB- from B+
summary: S&P Global Ratings raised Mexican flag carrier Aeromexico one notch to BB- from B+, keeping it below investment grade.
why: Credit rating upgrades can lower borrowing costs for airlines and signal improving financial health to institutional investors.

impacts.name: Aeromexico
impacts.why: A credit rating upgrade reflects improved creditworthiness for the company.
